scientific_integrity: Exact combinatorial decomposition, nullhomotopic attachment and integral chain-module proof; independently reproducible finite face, homology and Lefschetz checks.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite clique bouquets with at least two blades and independence parameter r at least three; no arbitrary-block-graph extension or equivariant homotopy splitting is asserted. Finite verification scripts do not replace the infinite-family proof; unindexed bibliographic overlap remains possible.
title: Higher-independence complexes of clique bouquets: exact mixed sphere wedges and integral symmetries
